settings.title: Settings
settings.general.subtitle: Control how Atlas Worker looks, stores files, and runs on this device.
settings.theme.help: System mode follows your device appearance.
settings.sidebar.help: Longer lists collapse behind “Show more”, separately for each agent and project.
settings.composer.contextHelp: Show how much of the model context window is occupied. Turn it off to show this task’s token total; the full breakdown remains one click away.
settings.files.help: Each task gets its own folder here. Existing tasks keep their current location, and you can grant access to other folders from a task.
settings.files.saved: Saved. New tasks will use this location.
settings.trusted.help: Trusted projects may manage command allowances in .coworker/config.toml.
settings.trusted.noAllowances: No project command allowances currently declared
settings.autostart.help: Launch Atlas Worker automatically when you sign in.
settings.keepAwake.help: Prevent idle sleep so automations run on time.
settings.setupHelp: Replay first-run setup: choose a model, create an automation, and review tips.
settings.update.error: Couldn’t check right now. Try again later.
settings.update.downloading: Downloading; Atlas Worker will restart when ready.
settings.models.subtitle: Manage model providers and the models available in the task composer. Keys stay on this device.
settings.models.removeKeyConfirm: Remove the {provider} key from this device?
settings.models.envKey: OPENAI_API_KEY is set in the server environment. You can override it above; the locally stored key is used only when the environment variable is absent.
settings.models.availableHelp: Checked models appear in the task composer; the Default badge marks the model used for new tasks.
settings.models.includedHelp: Curated agent-capable models from this provider. Add your key above to enable them.
settings.models.pickerHelp: Models available when starting a task. The Default badge marks the preferred model; add more from a provider card above.
settings.models.defaultLocked: The default model must remain. Make another model default first.
settings.tokenSavings.help: PDF attachments travel with every turn, so large documents continually increase token usage.
settings.pdfFallback: When a model cannot read PDF natively
settings.pdf.help: Claude, GPT, and Gemini read PDFs natively. This applies to models such as GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, and local models. Text extraction uses the fewest tokens; page images require a vision model and cost more.
settings.pdf.limitHelp: PDFs over these limits are not attached; the composer will show a notice.
settings.compaction.help: When a long task approaches its context limit, Atlas summarizes earlier work and continues. The visible transcript stays intact and marks where compaction occurred.
settings.compaction.capHelp: Even with very long-context models, compaction starts early enough to avoid quality and speed degradation near the limit.
settings.compaction.modelHelp: This model writes the compacted summary. The default follows the model used by the task.
settings.voice.subtitle: Speak naturally in the task composer. Recordings and transcripts remain on this device.
settings.voice.desktopOnly: Voice input is configured in the Atlas Worker desktop app.
settings.voice.privateHelp: Audio remains in memory only while recording and is transcribed locally.
settings.voice.micReady: Your microphone and local transcription engine are working.
settings.voice.micHelp: Record a short phrase to enable the task-composer microphone.
settings.voice.listening: ● Listening—say a short phrase, then stop.
settings.voice.deleteConfirm: Delete the local Whisper model and disable voice input?
settings.voice.noSpeech: No speech was detected. Try again and speak a little longer.
skills.subtitle: Reusable task methods Atlas can apply across all tasks. Turning one off here disables it everywhere.
skills.writeHelp: Provide a name, purpose, and execution instructions
skills.importHelp: Import a shared .zip or SKILL.md and review it before installation
skills.createWithAtlasHelp: Start a task where Atlas writes the Skill and asks before adding it
skills.reviewHelp: Read the instructions first. Once installed, Atlas follows them in matching tasks.

skills.descriptionPlaceholder: One line describing when Atlas should use this Skill
skills.instructionsPlaceholder:

skills.empty: No Skills yet. Choose “Add Skill” to teach Atlas its first workflow, such as preparing your Monday status report.
skills.confirmation: — Atlas can now use it in every task.
skills.offNote: turned off everywhere. If an existing task used it, start a new task for a clean context.
skills.deleteNote: removed. If an existing task used it, start a new task for a clean context.
provider.checkThenSave: Runs one read-only check, then saves.
provider.ollamaHelp: No API key needed. Ollama runs models on this device.
composer.inboxApprovalsHint: Approvals and questions go to Inbox so Atlas can keep working.
